title: Lint script detects registry-docs drift

brief.why: Anyone can edit a GENERATED section by hand or forget to run render.py — lint catches that drift before it compounds across sessions.
brief.what: 1. Create scripts/lint.py as PEP 723 script 2. Read brigade.toml and re-render all sections in memory (reusing render.py logic) 3. Compare rendered output against actual file content between markers 4. Print clear diff and exit 1 if any section is stale; exit 0 if clean 5. Test by deliberately editing a GENERATED section and confirming lint catches it
brief.done: uv run --script scripts/lint.py exits 0 on a clean repo; exits 1 with named diff output after deliberate GENERATED section edit
